verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a government online-application service could document a keyless or file-number entry path. However, the pack only shows public pre-application tools: eligibility questionnaires and a processing-times checker. It also has a bare 'Check your application status' link and an 'Accounts (GCKey…)' entry, and none of these documents starting the core application flow without an account or via a file number.
